extraction.placeName: Warschauer Brücke, Alexanderplatz, Görlitzer Park/Wrangelkiez, Kottbusser Tor
extraction.summaryEn: Police carried out evening and night control and presence operations at crime-affected places in central Berlin, including Kottbusser Tor and Görlitzer Park. The most serious single case was a 25-year-old man who resisted arrest after suspected cannabis dealing near Görlitzer Bahnhof, slightly injuring an officer.
